title: Lil Wayne Calls Out Refs After Green Bay Packers Loss: ‘I’m Out on the NFL This Year’
summary: "Fake af I can’t respect the game when the refs can’t ref the game," Weezy wrote on X.
contentText:
After just one game, Lil Wayne says he’s already done with the NFL for the 2026 season.

Weezy vented on X about what he feels was unfair officiating that led to the Green Bay Packers’ loss against their NFC North rival Minnesota Vikings on Sunday.

“Refs in Minnesota game pure p—y,” Wayne wrote. “Fake af I can’t respect the game when the refs can’t ref the game. I’m out on the NFL this year. Wish for it to be an amazing season for all. My Di- too big for short comings and this sux.”

The Packers blew a 22-10 lead and gave up 29 unanswered points in to finish the game in what became a 39-22 loss to Carson Wentz and the Vikings.

Wayne was frustrated by penalties called against GB that erased turnovers for the Packers and led to points for the Vikings, which continued to fuel Minnesota’s comeback.

In August, Lil Wayne teamed up with his beloved Packers to unveil the team’s Rivalries uniform for the 2026 season. Weezy crafted a new cheesehead-themed track for the ad, which is titled “Special Ops” and a full version landed on streaming services on Aug. 28.

Got Green & Yellow blood in my DNA.

How about you, @LilTunechi ? pic.twitter.com/H0ElRDRGug

— Green Bay Packers (@packers) August 25, 2026

It remains to be seen if Lil Wayne was caught up in a heated moment of frustration or if the New Orleans rap legend will be sticking to his guns and staying away from watching football this season.

With or without Wayne, the Green Bay Packers’ season continues with a week two match-up against the New York Jets at MetLife Stadium on Sunday (Sept. 20).

However, Weezy won’t be able to avoid professional athletics entirely as he hosts a weekly podcast with sports radio personality Craig Carton, which is titled The Joint Venture .
